lessons.title: The sense-think-act loop
lessons.summary: Every robot repeats three steps: sense, think, act.

quiz.q: What are the three steps of the loop?
quiz.why: A robot gathers data, decides, then moves.

quiz.q: Which part is the robot's muscle?
quiz.why: Actuators such as motors create movement.

quiz.q: Why does a robot keep sensing after it moves?

lessons.title: Sensors: how robots see the world
lessons.summary: Cameras, lidar and distance sensors compared.

quiz.q: Which sensor measures distance with laser pulses?
quiz.why: Lidar times how long a laser pulse takes to return.
Sensor fusion covers each sensor's blind spots.
